pd.az.name: Fallback
pd.az.title: When the fix drops, the heading holds.
pd.az.cap.1: With a fix, every sensor has its role: GNSS gives position, the magnetometer heading, the accelerometer tilt correction, the gyroscope smoothing.
pd.az.cap.2: When the fix drops, the IMU dead-reckons from the last known state — heading and motion estimates continue while the uncertainty grows.
pd.az.cap.3: When the satellites return, the estimate is corrected. Navigation degrades gracefully instead of failing on one sensor.
pd.az.aria: Diagram: a route with GNSS fixes; during a dropout the IMU dead-reckons and the position uncertainty grows, then the estimate is corrected when the fix returns.
pd.cl.name: Verification
pd.cl.title: Ten benches, one core.
pd.cl.cap.1: Nine unit benches verify every module of the datapath on its own.
pd.cl.cap.2: Then an integration bench proves the full ISA, checked against hand-computed values through a debug port.
pd.cl.aria: Diagram: nine unit benches and one integration bench, all passing.
pd.ne.name: Inference
pd.ne.title: From the lens to the NPU, with no round trip.
pd.ne.cap.1: Frames arrive from the camera over MIPI CSI-2 and are inferred on the STM32N6's NPU — on the board, with no cloud dependency.
pd.ne.cap.2: The second path: quantized object-detection models reach the NPU through STM32CubeMX.
pd.ne.aria: Diagram: camera frames travel over MIPI CSI-2 to the STM32N6 and its NPU, which outputs detections; a quantized model is deployed to the NPU through STM32CubeMX; the path to the cloud is cut.

about.exp.note: Build and release engineering for automotive electronic-systems validation.
about.exp.a1: Designed and built CONDUIT, a local-first release-control dashboard that joins Azure DevOps with Palantir Foundry and auto-summarizes deployment logs. It replaced a multi-page manual review and was adopted by full-time engineers.
about.exp.a2: Debugged failing LIN-bus lighting and engine-cranking security-access test scripts across the release pipeline, clearing most logged errors and restoring clean sign-off builds.
about.exp.a3: Found and patched a CI gate defect that let pull requests with zero linked work items report as passing.
about.hil.title: One validation pass, re-architected.
about.hil.before: Test cases ran one after another, and a hang could stall a full pass for up to 5.5 hours.
about.hil.after: I rebuilt the runner to execute cases in parallel. A full pass now takes about five minutes.
about.hil.aria: Diagram: a validation pass moving from sequential test cases, with a hang of up to 5.5 hours, to parallel cases that finish in about five minutes.
